cards.title: Borrowed Authority
cards.instruction: Project confident authority while quietly working to keep everyone cooperative. Your confidence depends on their cooperation.

cards.title: Apologize Properly
cards.instruction: Get someone to deliver the apology in the form, order, and setting you consider valid.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'd like to keep this voluntary. Please apologise for eating my cake at the table where it happened. Please.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'm still in charge; we can make an adjustment. It's a promising rehearsal. The cake plate is over there.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Your dad's sitting there. Can't we do this privately?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: He watched me blame the dog. Tell him you ate it before you tell me you're sorry.

mechanism: A directs an apology at the original table and accommodates privacy only after correcting the false account Dad heard.
confusable: Unlike merely seeking remorse, A specifies location and the confession-before-apology order that makes it valid.
comparison: Cake-table apology and a witness correction differ from editing a vase apology email.
seedUse: D171-a table, cake plate, Dad and blamed dog; S02-a does preparation and grants private setting after the necessary correction.
